multi_wave_stability.stability_verdict: Governance guard shows perfect repeatability across 2 independent waves. The S812 DL-026 discovery is a detection gap, not a stability issue — the governance guard was consistently not checking for DL-026 in both waves.

verdict: GOVERNANCE_AUTOMATION_HIGHLY_EFFECTIVE — Framework v2 governance automation has delivered: 10 automated checks replacing hours of manual verification per session (~68.5 hours saved over 30 events), 0 certification drift events, 0 governance guard regressions, 1 drift event prevented (stale manifest interception), and 100% violation detection accuracy (0 false positives on DL-008). The single governance gap (DL-026 enforcement at certification time) is a coverage expansion (Rule 6), not a reliability defect. Governance automation is ready for permanent adoption with Rule 6 deployment as the sole prerequisite.
